title: Perdu
summary: PERDU' PERDU'E, adverb [Latin perdo.] Close; in concealment. The moderator, out of view, Beneath the desk had lain perdue. PERDU', noun One that is placed on the watch or in ambush. PERDU', adjective

inlines.v: PERDU' PERDU'E, adverb [Latin perdo.] Close; in concealment. The moderator, out of view, Beneath the desk had lain perdue. PERDU', noun One that is placed on the watch or in ambush. PERDU', adjective Abandoned; employed on desperate purposes; accustomed to desperate purposes or enterprises.
